plugin.note: Bring dragonfire protection (anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield plus an antifire potion). Lava dragons have low actual Magic and Ranged levels, so ranged and magic are accurate against them; use low-risk Wilderness gear such as Craw's bow given the deep-Wilderness player-killing risk. Keep a one-click escape teleport ready.

requirements: Dragonfire protection (anti-dragon shield / dragonfire shield and an antifire potion)
Low-risk gear for the deep Wilderness
A one-click teleport for emergency escape
mechanics: Lava dragons use melee (slash) and short-ranged dragonfire (max 50 without protection).
Lava dragons are weak to water spells (50%).
Lava Dragon Isle is deep Wilderness and a popular player-killing hotspot.
All Krystilia lava dragon kills must occur on Lava Dragon Isle in the Wilderness.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Kill lava dragons on Lava Dragon Isle with dragonfire protection and low-risk gear.
requiredOrKeyItems: Craw's bow or Dragon hunter crossbow
steps: Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
Range or melee the lava dragons; their low actual Magic/Ranged levels make ranged accurate.
Watch the minimap for player killers and teleport if threatened.
notes: Lava dragon bones give strong Prayer XP at the nearby Chaos Altar but attract player killers.
The deep-Wilderness location makes escape difficult if attacked.

methods.label: Melee with Dragon hunter lance
methods.summary: Melee lava dragons for faster kills when accepting closer engagement.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dragon hunter lance or Viggora's chainmace
steps: Stand adjacent and melee with a dragonbane weapon for higher damage per hit.
Watch for the short-ranged dragonfire and keep antifire up.
Teleport immediately if a player killer approaches on the isle.
notes: Dragon hunter lance gains its dragonbane bonus against lava dragons.
Melee kills are faster but require standing in melee range in deep Wilderness.
